claim: Actors can share source bytes, so a colour map keyed on source address paints one actor on another; key colours to actor identity and check source identity, not only raw bytes.

evidence.text: Sheriff and bandits share bodies and legs, so a badge painted on one appears on the other; the fix uses the IX actor type with per-actor maps.
A record's frame number is not what is in the shared shift buffer at the plot: key colours to the bytes drawn.
A painted cache must check source identity as well as raw bytes, since another object with identical graphics can have different paint.
